alpha_preview: alpha-mask-preview.png; six representative masks per family on a checkerboard, enlarged nearest-neighbor for seam/alpha review
base_layer_requirement: The derived alpha-cut tiles need a lower opaque base layer (floor/wall/water underlay) in cells where the mask is transparent.

derivation.alpha_handling: Source alpha preserved. Isolated tiles retain their central core; each legal diagonal bit independently controls its8x8 corner.
derivation.method: full source swatch nearest-neighbor to 32px; permanent central16x16 core; four16px-wide side arms; independent8x8 corners for blob47; adjacent-side corners for wall Wang16
derivation.resampling: nearest-neighbor from complete source swatch; source bounds and scale listed per material
derivation.seams: Hard alpha edges at8px and24px; no invented edge texture or antialiasing.
